offering_description.value: Provides outsourced sterilization services (gamma irradiation, electron beam, ethylene oxide) for medical devices, pharmaceuticals and other products, plus lab testing and advisory services for medical device and pharma makers. Also supplies cobalt-60 and ethylene oxide. Customers are medical device manufacturers, pharmaceutical firms and other industrial companies.

primary_services.value: contract sterilization (gamma, e-beam, ethylene oxide); microbiological and analytical lab testing; medical device and pharma advisory and consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: medical device makers, pharmaceutical and biotech companies, food safety and other industrial manufacturers

end_markets.value: medical devices; pharmaceuticals; biotechnology; food safety; consumer and industrial products

revenue_model.value: service fees: per-load sterilization and lab testing and advisory fees; product sales: cobalt-60 and ethylene oxide sold to irradiator operators and sterilizers; project or contract: long-term sterilization and supply contracts with major customers
revenue_model.category: service fees; product sales; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: service provider: sterilizes and tests customer products at its own facilities for device and pharma manufacturers; asset operator: owns and runs gamma, e-beam and EO sterilization plants and labs; raw materials: supplies cobalt-60 sourced from reactors and ethylene oxide to sterilizers and processors
value_chain_position.category: service provider; asset operator; raw materials

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Asia, Latin America and other regions via facilities in about a dozen countries

specialization.value: related lines: sterilization services, lab testing and advisory, and isotope and gas supply for healthcare and industrial customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to device, pharma and industrial manufacturers; own locations: customers ship products to company sterilization and testing facilities

regulatory_exposure.value: high: ethylene oxide emissions regulated by EPA and state agencies, nuclear materials by NRC, FDA and ISO quality standards
